fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary urging hospitality toward tourists and criticizing civic bickering; discussion of U.S. government actions and law enforcement, including prohibition-era rum-running and the Christensen/Nesle matter with references to Nassau and extradition sentiment; coverage of Miami and Miami Beach municipal issues (harbor equipment and contracting, paving and grading, vacant lots/parks, public safety, and a Hialeah Thanksgiving proclamation); notes on unemployment among union musicians and hiring of an out-of-town orchestra; sports coverage and promotion of boxing events and university athletics; letters to the editor on civic communications, apartment economics/tenant practices, and reader responses to Miami Life content, alongside local advertisements.
